description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the submission is well-formed; no ceiling or window verdict is returned.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

challenge.description: The one upto challenge: scheme, network, payTo, asset, max_amount_required (the ceiling), asset_decimals.

evaluation_at_unix.description: The evaluation instant, unix seconds. The window is evaluated at this instant, never at a hidden clock.

payload.description: The one signed-payload descriptor whose validity window is evaluated: rail plus its validity fields (e.g. valid_before for EVM).

name: validity_check_precheck
